scope: All dynamically discovered Android app roots; not an assertion that every unknown engine cache format has been classified
required_context: Built-in basenames are recognized only under app top-level cache/code_cache/.cache/app_<engine>. Names elsewhere remain unknown unless optional private classifications bind their exact current type/content to independently inspected purpose.
system_compositor_evidence: 2026-11-07 parent executor read-only device inspection explicitly found these two derived caches; stop SurfaceFlinger before applying; never move containing data/misc directories.

sources.evidence: docs/HANDOFF.md 2026-11-05; original private chrome-cache/VERIFICATION.txt records five moved locations, ROLLBACK_HASH_MATCH and Chrome stopped; this is Chrome-only historical validation

runtime_dependency: BusyBox ash and documented applets; no Python
caller_contract: Observe actual backend before/after; stop all graphics consumers; call only for a real change; provide CE-unlocked user IDs from authoritative runtime state; block affected app launches while CE/unknown/access failures remain pending. --quiesced is recorded caller attestation, not independent proof.
rollback: Same-parent atomic rename; complete private manifest and content/ownership/mode hashes; preserve SELinux/xattrs by rename; refuse destination conflicts or changed backup. Rollback data alone does not switch the GPU driver.
evidence_classifications: Optional private --classification-file, exact content/type checks only for previously unknown discovered objects; see graphics-backend-cache-classifications.md. Source-directory descendants remain scanned; no package/user whitelist.
